verdict.rationale: A live probe found a working llms.txt at docs.openwebui.com that describes itself as machine-readable entry points and a curated index of every docs page, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. The api-endpoints reference is also served as a .md page, which further suggests agent-friendly markdown docs. Missing for 10: no first-party docs page describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent-docs surface, no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), no independent corroboration of agents consuming it.
